cards.altText: A network edge is not always a direct interaction. SYSTEMS BIOLOGY Ask what the connection means. Two paper nodes joined by a thread with a question tag, larger abstract network behind.

Use case: scientific-educational. Make ONE finished Instagram carousel card, SQUARE 1:1 aspect ratio requested 1080x1080. Full bleed with 80px safe margins. Brand top ANGSUMI; footer @angsumi.online and supplied card number. Use only EXACT supplied headline and body and explicitly requested tiny conceptual label. a direct interaction.". Body exact: "SYSTEMS BIOLOGY
Ask what the connection means.". Visual: Two paper nodes joined by a thread with a question tag, larger abstract network behind.. Footer number "1/6".

cards.altText: Networks encode different relationships. Physical interaction. Regulation. Statistical association. Three separate network cards with explicit relationship labels and different line styles; no inference one implies another.
